race.comment: The first leg of the quaddie is over 2400m at BM72 level. GOLDEN CENTURY (2) may not win often, but as his form suggests, he is heading the right way with his form after stepping out to this trip late last season. He slides down a class here, and is likely to be powering home late. JMac sticks with him, and so do we. GRAFTON STREET (3) is a very promising young stayer who capped off some good form with a brave nose win off the front at Warwick Farm 3 weeks ago. He doesn't have to lead here, and is sure to be a big each-way threat again. ANDRON (5) overcame some early buffeting to arrive with a well-timed run to score by half-a-length at Hawkesbury nearly 3 weeks ago. He drops 2kg with the jump in class, and will also try this trip for the first time, but he is very progressive, so stick with him. CRITERIA (4) was just beaten fresh up over a mile, before scoring a comfortable win at Kembla Grange last start when coming from near last to score by a length. He can repeat the dose.
